english.title: Run an aircraft engine in a hangar / area not allocated for that purpose within Gatwick Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the permission of Gatwick Airport Limited having first been obtained or lawful authority or excuse ran an aircraft engine in

(A)_[a hangar]_
(B)_[an area other than that allocated for that purpose by the company, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AREA..)]_

within Gatwick Airport - London
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 4(1) and 2(2) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
